intro.fr: Ape Escape 2 se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Ape Escape 2 can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: SCE Japan Studio sort Ape Escape 2 en 2002.
text.en: SCE Japan Studio releases Ape Escape 2 in 2002.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub dannybonz/ae2_archipelago, qui héberge l'APWorld de Ape Escape 2.
text.en: The GitHub repository dannybonz/ae2_archipelago, home of the Ape Escape 2 APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, v1.0.0.
text.en: The first version, v1.0.0, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version v1.3.4, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (9 versions publiées).
text.en: Version v1.3.4 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (9 versions released).

text.fr: Ape Escape 2 figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Ape Escape 2 is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
